% Built twice into one build folder by a job of test/run.mjs. imakeidx's
% index with a makeindex style that is missing, and glossaries with a style
% file that is missing, so makeindex fails for both. Each has its sorted
% file beside the document, current, as an Overleaf zip ships it. The
% document has one LaTeX error of its own, \undefinedcs. The page's index
% and glossary are read from the files beside the document, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{imakeidx}
\makeindex[options=-s test-staleaux-ind-gone]
\usepackage{glossaries}
\noist
\setStyleFile{test-staleaux-ind-gone}
\makeglossaries
\newglossaryentry{fruit}{name={fruit},description={the seed-bearing part of a plant}}
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple} is a \gls{fruit}.\undefinedcs
\printindex
\printglossary
\end{document}
